scheduling.skillGoal: Compress source documents into a lossless LLM-optimized distillate that preserves every fact, decision, constraint, and relationship
scheduling.intentSignature: Distill source documents into a lossless LLM-optimized distillate
intentSignatures: Distill source documents into a lossless LLM-optimized distillate
Lossless LLM-optimized compression of source documents
Create a distillate from source files for downstream LLM consumption
Produce a hyper-compressed token-efficient document set from sources
triggerPatterns: the user requests to 'distill documents' or 'create a distillate'
downstream LLM workflow needs a single dense context input from many sources

ioContract.inputsRaw: source_documents (required) — file paths, folder paths, or glob patterns; downstream_consumer (optional) — workflow name; token_budget (optional) — target size; output_path (optional) — destination; --validate (flag) — round-trip reconstruction test
ioContract.outputsRaw: { status, distillate, section_distillates, source_total_tokens, distillate_total_tokens, compression_ratio, source_documents, completeness_check }

preconditions: source_documents paths are accessible on the local filesystem
scripts/analyze_sources.py is available in the skill bundle
subagent spawning is available (graceful degradation otherwise)

structural.sceneGoal: Validate caller-provided arguments and route to Stage 1
Analyze source documents to determine routing and grouping
Spawn compressor subagents and produce intermediate or final distillates
Run completeness and format checks then save the distillate and report
Reconstruct sources from the distillate and produce a validation report when --validate is set

logical.description: Read original source documents and reconstructions to perform a section-by-section semantic diff during round-trip validation
Validate caller arguments (source_documents required; others optional) and route to Stage 1
Run scripts/analyze_sources.py with the source paths to obtain routing recommendation and group manifest
Spawn one or more distillate-compressor subagents to produce intermediate distillates from source groups
Spawn a final merge compressor over the intermediate distillates for cross-group dedup, thematic regrouping, and final compression
If subagent spawning is unavailable, read the source documents and perform the compression work directly using the same instructions
Verify each source heading and named entity returned by the compressor appears in the distillate content; on gap send a targeted fix pass (max 2)
Verify the distillate follows format rules — bullets only, no decoration, no repetition, self-contained bullets, themed `##` headings
Save the distillate as a single file with frontmatter, or as a folder with _index.md and section files when split is required
Run scripts/analyze_sources.py on the final distillate output(s) to compute distillate_total_tokens
Return structured JSON with status, distillate path(s), token counts, compression ratio, source list, and completeness_check
Spawn round-trip-reconstructor subagent(s) with only the distillate path(s) to attempt source reconstruction without seeing originals
Produce the validation report file adjacent to the distillate as `<distillate>-validation-report.md` with summary, gaps, hallucinations, and possible-gap markers
If gaps are found, offer a targeted fix pass on the distillate (max 2 fix passes), adding missing information without full recompression
Delete temporary reconstruction files after the validation report is generated
